verdict.rationale: Together AI offers building blocks that could support background automation — async batch inference jobs (together-ai-docs-3) and agentic multi-step/multi-turn function-calling loops (together-ai-docs-9, together-ai-docs-16) — but there is no documented feature for scheduling, triggering, or persistently running autonomous background automations as a platform capability. Missing for 10: a scheduler/trigger system, persistent background agent runtime, or any 'automation' product surface beyond batch jobs and raw agentic API primitives.
